tokens.name: color-bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, metadata asides, tonal regions.

tokens.name: color-bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Tooltip-free raised layers: frames, dropdowns. Pair with border-default.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body on every bg. ≥15.07:1 light, ≥13.19:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, inactive nav, metadata values. ≥6.45:1 light, ≥8.64:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on action-primary, hover and pressed fills. 5.17 / 7.02 / 9.17:1 light, 7.45 / 9.55 / 11.26:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-text-link
tokens.usage: Link text on every bg (A1). 5.65–7.02:1 light, 5.68–7.45:1 dark. Weight 500 is the non-colour cue at rest; underline on hover.

tokens.name: color-text-link-visited
tokens.usage: Same as link, by decision: one accent, no purple.

tokens.name: color-text-on-image
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-overlay-scrim. 7.60:1 worst case over white imagery.

tokens.name: color-border-default
tokens.usage: Card, panel and frame edges; decorative. Never the only cue.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Strong divider, emphasis rule. ≥3:1 on every bg in v1.1.

tokens.name: color-border-control
tokens.usage: Boundaries that must be seen: inputs, thumbnails, toggles. 3.03–3.77:1 light, 3.03–3.98:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-border-button
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline. Light silver (1.53:1) is allowed because the label identifies the button (WCAG 1.4.11 needs no boundary for text buttons); dark keeps dark-border-strong.

tokens.name: color-action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Not for text links (use color-text-link).

tokens.name: color-action-selected-bg
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, toggled button, current thumbnail backing.

tokens.name: color-selected-indicator
tokens.usage: 2px bar or ring marking selection, with aria-current. ≥4.56:1 light, ≥5.68:1 dark on every bg.

tokens.name: color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline at 3px offset. ≥5.65:1 light, ≥6.12:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-state-success
tokens.usage: Success icon and word. Never colour alone.

tokens.name: color-state-info
tokens.usage: Info icon and word. Shares the link hue, so the icon is mandatory.

tokens.name: color-disabled-text
tokens.usage: Disabled labels. Exempt from 1.4.3 but kept ≥3:1.

tokens.name: color-overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Bars and captions over imagery; video controls.

tokens.name: color-overlay-backdrop
tokens.usage: Lightbox backdrop. White text 15.34:1 even over white imagery.

tokens.name: color-badge-bg
tokens.usage: Badge tag fill: white at 55% (6% in dark), so tags sit quietly on any surface or project wash. Frosted, no blur.

tokens.name: color-badge-border
tokens.usage: Badge tag edge: ink at 8% (white at 10% in dark). Decorative; the text carries the meaning. High contrast swaps in color-border-default.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Instrument Sans at 90% width (font-width-display). Responsive: steps up at 768px and 1024px via responsiveType.

tokens.name: font-width-display

tokens.name: radius-lg

shadow.note: Flat but dimensional: a light 1px ring plus soft, Midnight-tinted, negative-spread shadows (layered like Stripe). Never as the only edge.

tokens.usage: Flat elements: nav, links, badges, inputs, frameless cards.

tokens.name: shadow-xs

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Hover on interactive surfaces (outlined cards, link tiles, thumbnails); tooltip.

typeScale.note: Same values as the type styles, exposed as the vars tokens.css defines, so component CSS is portable.

responsiveType.note: bundle.css re-points --type-*/--line-* to these at 768px and 1024px.

tokens.name: tracking-display
tokens.usage: Display styles (Instrument Sans needs less than Geist did).

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Keeps the ring on the ground, not the fill (ring vs cobalt fill is 1.36:1).

tokens.name: control-height-xs
tokens.usage: Inline and table actions, tag-adjacent controls. Keep 8px or more between targets.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbars, panel headers, secondary nav actions.

tokens.name: control-height-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, nav items, icon buttons (44px on touch).

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Hero call to action (52px on touch).

control.note: Compact for pointers (Linear, Geist); touch sizes follow Apple HIG via pointer: coarse.

breakpoint.note: Container queries use these literal values (CSS cannot read vars in conditions).
